title: Future perfect and future continuous
titleVi: Tương lai hoàn thành và tương lai tiếp diễn
summary: Diễn đạt việc sẽ hoàn tất trước một mốc tương lai và việc đang diễn ra tại mốc đó — cấu trúc ghi điểm ở band 8.
whyItMatters: Hai thì này cho phép bạn nói chính xác *trước* và *tại* một thời điểm tương lai, điều mà `will` không làm được. Trong Task 2 về chính sách dài hạn hay Task 1 có năm dự báo, chúng tạo ra sắc thái thời gian mà giám khảo coi là dấu hiệu của band 8.0.

sections.heading: Future continuous: in progress at a future moment
body: The future continuous is **will be + -ing**. It describes an activity that will be in progress at a particular time in the future, or a future event that is simply expected to happen in the normal course of things.
It is the natural answer to *What will you be doing at this time next year?* — a very common Speaking Part 1 and 3 question.
It also softens a request or an assumption: *You'll be needing a visa for that trip* sounds more considerate than *You will need a visa*.

examples.right: At this time next year, I will be working in a research institute.
examples.note: Activity in progress at a future moment.

examples.right: Don't call me at eight — I'll be presenting at the conference.
By 2035, most households will be using smart meters.

sections.heading: Future perfect: completed before a future deadline
body: The future perfect is **will have + past participle**. It says that an action will be finished before a stated future point.
The deadline is usually introduced by **by**, **by the time**, **before**, or **by then**: *By 2030, the city will have built three new metro lines.*
The difference from the future continuous is completion. *At 8 p.m. I will be writing the report* (still in progress) versus *By 8 p.m. I will have written the report* (finished before then).

examples.right: By 2030, the city will have built three new metro lines.
By the time you arrive, I will have finished the presentation.
examples.note: **by the time** + present simple in the time clause.

examples.right: The committee will have reviewed all applications by Friday.
examples.wrong: The committee will review all applications by Friday.
examples.note: **by Friday** + a completion focus needs the perfect form.

sections.heading: Future perfect continuous: duration up to a future point
body: The future perfect continuous is **will have been + -ing**. It emphasises how long an activity will have lasted by a future moment.
It is the rarest of the three and usually needs an explicit duration: *By next June, I will have been studying English for ten years.*
Use it when the duration is the point. If you only need to say the action is finished, the future perfect is enough.

examples.right: By next June, I will have been studying English for ten years.
examples.note: Duration measured up to a future point.

examples.right: By 2040, the plant will have been operating for half a century.
examples.note: Long duration before a future date.

examples.right: When the project ends, the team will have been working together for eight years.
examples.note: Duration at the end of a future period.

sections.heading: The time clause rule: no will after by the time
body: In a clause introduced by **by the time**, **when**, **before**, **after** or **as soon as**, use the present simple (or present perfect), never **will**.
*By the time you arrive* — not *by the time you will arrive*. The main clause carries the future perfect.
This mirrors the rule for the first conditional and is tested constantly in advanced exams.

rows: in progress at a future moment
By 9 a.m. I'll have taught two classes.
duration up to a future point
By 9 a.m. I'll have been teaching for two hours.

sections.heading: Using the forms in IELTS Task 1 and Task 2
body: Task 1 projections often cover a period ending in a future year. Use **will have + V3** when the chart implies completion by that year, and **will be + -ing** when it implies an ongoing state.
Task 2 long-term arguments benefit from both: *By 2050, many coastal cities will have invested heavily in flood defences, and their populations will be adapting to permanent flooding.*
Keep the register formal: contract to *will* rather than *'ll*, and avoid combining these forms with vague adverbs like *soon*.

examples.right: By 2050, the figure will have doubled to around 40%.
examples.note: Completion by a projected year in Task 1.

examples.right: By 2050, most of the workforce will be working remotely at least two days a week.
examples.note: Ongoing state in a Task 2 projection.

examples.right: By the time the policy is reviewed, the government will have spent over 5 billion dollars.
examples.wrong: By the time the policy will be reviewed, the government will have spent over 5 billion dollars.
examples.note: Mệnh đề **by the time** không dùng **will**.

commonMistakes.wrong: By 2030, I will finish my degree.
commonMistakes.right: By 2030, I will have finished my degree.
commonMistakes.why: `By + mốc tương lai` nhấn mạnh việc hoàn tất trước mốc đó, nên cần `future perfect`. `Will finish` chỉ nói việc sẽ xảy ra, không nói đã xong trước mốc.

commonMistakes.wrong: At this time tomorrow, I will work in the lab.
commonMistakes.right: At this time tomorrow, I will be working in the lab.
commonMistakes.why: Hành động đang diễn ra tại một thời điểm tương lai cụ thể cần `future continuous`.

commonMistakes.wrong: By the time you will arrive, I will have left.
commonMistakes.right: By the time you arrive, I will have left.
commonMistakes.why: Mệnh đề thời gian với `by the time` dùng `present simple`, không dùng `will`.

commonMistakes.wrong: I will have been knowing her for ten years by next month.
commonMistakes.right: I will have known her for ten years by next month.
commonMistakes.why: `know` là stative verb, không có dạng tiếp diễn. Dùng `future perfect` đơn giản.

commonMistakes.wrong: By 2050, the population will be doubled.
commonMistakes.right: By 2050, the population will have doubled.
commonMistakes.why: `double` ở đây là nội động từ (tự tăng gấp đôi), không phải bị động. Dùng `will have doubled` để chỉ kết quả hoàn tất.

ieltsTips: Trong Task 1 có năm dự báo, dùng `will have + V3` khi biểu đồ ngụ ý hoàn tất, và `will be + V-ing` khi ngụ ý trạng thái đang tiếp diễn tại năm đó.
Trong Task 2, kết hợp hai thì trong một câu để tạo chiều sâu thời gian: `By 2050, cities will have invested ..., and residents will be adapting ...`
Giữ đúng quy tắc mệnh đề thời gian: sau `by the time`, `when`, `before` dùng `present simple` hoặc `present perfect`, tuyệt đối không dùng `will`.
Viết đầy đủ `will` thay vì `'ll` trong Writing Task 1 và Task 2 để giữ văn phong trang trọng.

exercises.question: By 2030, the government ___ the new rail network.
exercises.explanation: **By 2030** + hoàn tất trước mốc đó → **future perfect**.

exercises.question: Don't phone at seven — I ___ dinner then.
exercises.explanation: Hành động đang diễn ra tại thời điểm tương lai → **future continuous**.

exercises.question: Which sentence uses the present simple correctly after 'by the time'?
options: By the time you will arrive, I will have left.
By the time you arrive, I will have left.
By the time you arrive, I have left.
By the time you will arrive, I leave.
exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề **by the time** dùng **present simple**; mệnh đề chính dùng **future perfect**.

exercises.question: By next June, she ___ English for ten years.
exercises.explanation: Thời lượng kéo dài tính đến một mốc tương lai → **future perfect continuous**.

exercises.question: Which sentence describes a completed result by a future date?
options: At 8 p.m. I will be writing the report.
By 8 p.m. I will have written the report.
At 8 p.m. I will write the report.
By 8 p.m. I write the report.
exercises.explanation: **By 8 p.m. + will have written** = hoàn tất trước mốc 8 giờ.

exercises.question: By 2050, the figure ___ (double) to around 40%.
exercises.explanation: **By + năm tương lai** + kết quả hoàn tất → future perfect.

exercises.question: At this time tomorrow, the delegates ___ (listen) to the opening speech.
exercises.explanation: Hành động đang diễn ra tại thời điểm tương lai cụ thể → future continuous.

exercises.question: By the time the project ends, the team ___ (work) together for eight years.
exercises.hint: By the time ... for eight years
exercises.explanation: Thời lượng kéo dài đến mốc tương lai → future perfect continuous.

exercises.question: The city ___ (invest) over 5 billion dollars in flood defences by 2040.
exercises.explanation: Hoàn tất trước mốc **by 2040** → future perfect.

exercises.question: When the new terminal opens, passenger numbers ___ (rise) for a decade.
exercises.explanation: Quá trình kéo dài tính đến mốc tương lai **opens** → future perfect continuous.
